title: validate-report/1
description: Validación de engine-input/1 sin resolver: contrato, límites y topología. No certifica estabilidad ni convergencia. Código de salida 0/1/2 para ok/warning/invalid.

entity_kind.description: Kind of the missing entity on a broken reference. Absent on every other diagnostic.

missing_id.description: Id that was sought. Absent when entity_kind is absent.

referenced_by.description: Path of the citation, for example members[3].nodes[1]. Each index is the 0-based position in that model collection.

suggestions.description: Nearby ids of the same kind, ordered by the documented Levenshtein rule. Absent when none qualify.
